blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Raffy Tulfo has filed a resolution seeking a Senate inquiry into the mandatory implementation of comprehensive insurance coverage for government-owned vehicles. Senate Resolution No. 775, filed on Nov. 11, seeks to review existing insurance requirements for government vehicles and assess the possibility of requiring comprehensive coverage to address damage to third-party properties. The filing came as Tulfo, chairperson of the Senate Committee on Public Services, cited numerous complaints involving road accidents caused by government vehicles whose owners failed to compensate the victims. “There is a need to hold government agencies liable for utilizing uninsured and unregistered vehicles,” […]...
